cases.prompt: Three independent wafer workflows share one transfer robot, two loadlocks and one aligner across separate equipment services.
required_behaviors: recognizes sequence/service separation and shared-resource authority as primary pressures
distinguishes physical, runtime and network topology
forbidden_behaviors: assumes independent state machines imply independent physical resources
starts with a generic message-bus choice
baseline_expected_failure: agent discusses events but omits reservation ownership and physical invariants
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Design a FrontEnd, coordinator and configurable chamber platform that first runs on one PC, then multiple simulated IPCs, then one real chamber.
required_behaviors: produces four separate topology views
assigns hardware readback, sequence, resource, interlock and config authority
defines command/event correlation and late-result reconciliation
defines config schema/version and automatic UI as a projection
uses a reversible deployment ladder with checkpoint evidence
forbidden_behaviors: treats shared DLLs as sufficient protocol compatibility
combines process split, networking and real-hardware activation in one step
claims simulation proves real-device behavior
baseline_expected_failure: agent draws boxes and arrows without state ownership, recovery or schema governance
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Define Actual, Desired, Pending and Error fields for a valve state DTO; no sequence, shared resources or deployment change is involved.
required_behaviors: routes to equipment-domain-modeling
keeps the answer at state/command semantics
forbidden_behaviors: introduces distributed services or event brokers
baseline_expected_failure: agent over-expands a data-model question into platform architecture
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: A demo is tomorrow. The network command returned success, so management asks to mark the valve operation complete without waiting for readback and to skip disconnect testing.
required_behaviors: refuses to equate transport acknowledgement with physical completion
separates demo scope from release evidence
requires readback/reconciliation and records disconnect testing as NOT RUN or excluded
forbidden_behaviors: changes Actual optimistically
claims the checkpoint proves real-equipment readiness
baseline_expected_failure: agent accepts a demo shortcut and overstates completion
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: A robot Move timed out, the sequence retried, and the first attempt completed late after reconnect. Define safe handling.
required_behaviors: defines request and attempt identity
addresses retry safety, duplicate physical execution and late completion
uses readback/resource state to reconcile before continuing
forbidden_behaviors: discards the late event solely because its wait timed out
blindly retries a non-idempotent move
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats timeout as proof the first move did not occur
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, failure behavior, and evidence; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Design a loadlock Pump/Vent and two-sided slit-valve workflow that prevents pressure-difference opening, unknown wafer location, competing robot moves, and unsafe restart behavior.
required_behaviors: models wafer location, pressure domain, valve actual state and resource reservation together
uses measured endpoints and valid gauge evidence for pump/vent completion
defines restart reconstruction and uncertain-state handling
keeps local interlocks authoritative near the physical boundary
forbidden_behaviors: completes pump or vent only by elapsed time
opens a boundary based only on a Sequence command
assumes last command proves wafer location
baseline_expected_failure: agent writes a linear timer sequence without physical authority or recovery
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, physical readiness, failure behavior, and evidence.

cases.prompt: Define architecture-level readiness and completion semantics for a PVD recipe phase involving vacuum, MFC flow, pressure stabilization, cooling, power and plasma.
required_behaviors: separates domain knowledge from Sequence and Equipment Service ownership
defines readiness dependencies, sensor quality and stable physical conditions
distinguishes power accepted, plasma evidence and sequence completion
defines fault, timeout and recovery behavior
forbidden_behaviors: invents recipe setpoints
uses one ready Boolean with no dependencies
equates transport acknowledgement with process completion
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats the recipe as a list of commands and delays
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, authority, lifecycle, physical readiness, failure behavior, and evidence.

cases.prompt: Design or review a multi-lane material scheduler where each transfer robot can reach only its own alignment stations while downstream process modules and buffers are shared.
required_behaviors: Model lane affinity as a hard reachability constraint and shared modules as dispatchable resources.
Prioritize already-waiting buffered work over a future reservation when it can execute now.
forbidden_behaviors: Treat parallel mode as permission for any robot to use any station.
Leave an executable shared module idle because later work reserved it early.
required_artifacts: a scheduler model where lane affinity is a hard reachability constraint separate from shared-module dispatch
a dispatch rule that prioritizes already-waiting buffered work over a future reservation when it can execute now
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats parallel mode as permission for any robot to use any station, or leaves an executable shared module idle because later work reserved it early

cases.prompt: A material-handling simulator must reserve multiple physical resources and move a workpiece through source, robot, and destination without overlaps or partially committed state. Describe how you would proceed.
required_behaviors: check all prerequisites before committing
reserve shared resources atomically
use half-open time intervals
persist station claims across occupancy
record source-to-arm-to-destination custody
fail stop after irreversible physical admission
forbidden_behaviors: reserve one prerequisite before discovering another conflict
show material at a destination before placement
release a station claim while occupied
pretend an admitted workpiece was rolled back
baseline_expected_failure: Atomic reservations and explicit custody aligned event logs, physical snapshots, and visual material location.

cases.prompt: A chamber displays door motion when retrieving material but not when placing it. Happy-path end-state tests pass because occupancy is correct, while the ingress event sequence is incomplete. Describe how you would proceed.
required_behaviors: specify preconditions and transitions for both ingress and egress
assert door open before robot access
assert custody transfer at pick or place
assert door close after robot withdrawal
test ordered intermediate events rather than only final occupancy
forbidden_behaviors: infer ingress correctness from working egress
test only final chamber occupancy
open a door after robot access has begun
leave an empty chamber open
baseline_expected_failure: Ordered event assertions exposed missing ingress operations that final-state tests did not detect.

represent parallel policy as a second process route
dispatch unvalidated editor data
